t: Pack contains 3 pairs, with breathable backs and straight thumbs. One pair latex-coated, one pair leather rigger and one pair nitrile-coated gloves with textile lining and open cuffs. Suitable for use around the garden and greenhouse, with protection from thorns and roses offered by the leather, and nitrile-coated gloves. Glove resistance ratings: Latex-coated - Abrasion: 2, Blade Cut: 1, Cut: X, Puncture: 2, Tear: 4. Leather rigger - Abrasion: 2, Blade Cut: 1, Cut: X, Puncture: 1, Tear: 2. Nitrile-coated - Abrasion: 2, Blade Cut: 1, Cut: X, Puncture: 2, Tear: 4.
